kept: every distinct (page, filename) whose stored trash verdict the new pack words turn into a keep, given the Jev answers recorded for it. refused: wrong keeps an earlier draft of the words made and the final words do not: another series' Дилогия the model saw no title of the movie in, Kolekcjoner (a collector), kolekcjonerskie (a collector's edition) and the Czech Kolekce.
humanLabel: PACK holds the movie, MOVIE is the movie, OTHER is not the movie, EITHER could not be decided from the name. Labelled by reading the filename against the page.
movies holds each page's IMDb titles built as getMovieContext builds them; ambiguous is left out, because the pack branch is decided before it.
